# Tour voice clips

<!-- Generated by web/scripts/narrate.ts; never edit by hand. -->

Each clip is one line of the guided tour, in its host's voice: cloned (with his consent) from one of Lewis Moten's
own voice recordings by [Pocket TTS](https://huggingface.co/kyutai/pocket-tts) (Kyutai, CC BY 4.0), or one of
[Kokoro](https://huggingface.co/hexgrad/Kokoro-82M)'s stock voices (hexgrad, Apache-2.0), both running locally,
then shifted in pitch and speed for the character (`HOSTS` in `web/src/tour/steps.ts`). `index.json` has the same
list for the tour to read.

From `web/`: `npm run voice` records the lines that are new or whose words changed, and rewrites this file and
`index.json`; `npm run voice -- --only <id>` records one clip again (each take differs); `npm run voice:all`
records every clip again.
